verdict.rationale: Forter's MCP server explicitly claims to let an AI system perform 'reviewing decisions, managing disputes' via natural language, and connects to Claude Desktop for conversational workflows, which is on-topic for an agent working a review queue. However, there is no documentation of the specific workflow described in the story (pulling flagged cases with full context, summarizing evidence, and producing a recommendation for human confirmation) — the MCP docs are a single thin line, and dispute-evidence recommendation tooling (forter-docs-10/15/25) is a separate automated feature, not agent-driven human-in-the-loop review. Missing for 10: concrete MCP tool/action list for case review, an example of context retrieval + evidence summarization, and any human-confirmation step in the workflow.
